name: Jupyter
description: Jupyter notebook support for Nimbalyst: custom `.ipynb` editor with real kernel execution via an in-process Pyodide kernel. Local-Python kernel option is a follow-up release.
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.longDescription: Open, edit, and execute .ipynb files in a first-class notebook editor. Cells run against an in-process Pyodide kernel — no Python install required — and the same editor will run against your local Python (jupyter_server) in a follow-up release. JupyterLab-grade rendering for code, markdown, HTML, images, LaTeX, errors, and ipywidgets. nbformat round-trip preserves cell IDs and metadata. The agent reads notebooks via a compact projection (jupyter.get_notebook_projection) that hides large outputs by default.
highlights: Real cell execution via in-process Pyodide kernel, zero install
JupyterLab-grade mime rendering (HTML, images, LaTeX, errors, ipywidgets)
AI tool: compact notebook projection that hides large outputs
nbformat round-trip preserves cell IDs and metadata
